dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-03
dates.summary:
**AI agents eat the work stack**: Codex expands from devs into knowledge work, Claude Code adds workflows, Gemini exposes Thinking Levels; **yes-code vs no-code** becomes the new platform fight as Vercel, Replit, OpenClaw, and enterprise sandboxes race to make agent-built apps deployable; **Listen Labs reframes market research**: thousands of AI voice interviews, emotion signals, traceable clips, and customer simulation turn “ask users” from slow theater into live product radar.

**智能体开始吞掉工作流**：Codex 走出开发者圈，Claude Code 加上 workflows，Gemini 把 Thinking Levels 放到全端；**no-code 被 yes-code 反杀**：Vercel、Replit、OpenClaw 都在抢“让智能体写完就能上线”的底座；**Listen Labs 把用户调研改成雷达**：AI 同时跑上千个语音访谈，看表情、留证据、回连销售数据，比问卷狠多了。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-02
dates.summary:
**DeepMind’s origin story gets sharper**: Demis Hassabis moves from one-lab AGI dreams to government-enforced safety; **agent workflows keep getting real**: builders trade worktrees, cross-model reviews, voice prompts, and Codex swarms; **model distribution heats up**: OpenAI-on-AWS chatter, MiniMax M3’s agent benchmark claim, and enterprise data moats dominate the feed.

**DeepMind 的旧账被翻出来了**：Demis 从“一个实验室搞定 AGI”走到“得靠政府定规矩”；**AI agent 不再只是口号**：worktree、交叉审查、语音提示、Codex 常驻跑任务，全是实操味；**模型入口开始抢人**：AWS、MiniMax M3、企业数据护城河一起冒头，热闹但不空泛。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-05-31
dates.summary:
English: Today’s snapshot covers **Claude Managed Agents** adding dreaming, outcomes, orchestration, and webhooks; **Gemini** co-lead Oriol Vinyals on world models, multimodal learning, RL, memory, and robotics; plus builder posts on **Codex**, **GPT-5.5**, **Vercel AI Gateway**, **Cursor** auto-review, AI education, enterprise AI investment, and California politics.

中文：今天的快照包括 **Claude Managed Agents** 新增 dreaming、outcomes、多智能体编排和 webhooks；**Gemini** 联合负责人 Oriol Vinyals 谈世界模型、多模态学习、RL、记忆和机器人；以及关于 **Codex**、**GPT-5.5**、**Vercel AI Gateway**、**Cursor** auto-review、AI 教育、企业 AI 投入和加州政治的 builder 动态。
